$comment: The deep amber (design §6/§7): the only window the ground still opens onto the deep past, surfaced piece by authored piece at one zone's observation site (the Hollows). Pieces arrive strictly in authored order — the sequence IS the story, so nothing is randomised but the timing. findsPerHour is per watcher before digSpeedMult modifiers; pityHoursWatched guarantees the next piece after that many watched hours without one (these lore lines are load-bearing — they must not starve). Collecting every piece completes the plate: its effects join the run's active-effect union and, like every plate, survive Migration (the journal keeps it). Piece lore lives inline (each is its own channel entry, ~1,200-word budget); completedLore is the finished plate's field note. Rates are first guesses.

deepAmber.completedLore: An insect no one living has seen, held in resin. The world it flew through has ended. It is in the book now — the one thing the land let me keep.

pieces.name: The Wing
pieces.lore: A wing in the resin, veined like nothing the trail knows. Whatever sky it flew, that sky has ended.

pieces.name: The Seed
pieces.lore: A seed, held mid-fall. Something planted in rows once, and widely. The rows are under the meadow.

pieces.name: The Ash
pieces.lore: Ash caught through the amber like a held breath. The tree wept this the year the sky went dark, and kept weeping.

pieces.name: The Maker's Mark
pieces.lore: A cut face, too straight for teeth. Someone worked this resin before it set. Their hands would have fit my gloves.
